name: Dadao
personality: Brash, flirtatious self-described former problem child who still looks out for the weak.
story: Dadao travels with Anatolia as part of the Pale Raven's Bridal Party, constantly flirting with her and other women. He loves machines, good food and fighting. Recruitment requires Support with him plus 2x Kothar Gar, with Renown gates that differ by route (5 on Theodora/Leda, 7 on Cai, 10 on Dietrich).

personalSkill.name: One Chance
personalSkill.effect: If unit and foe cannot make a follow-up, grants Atk+5 during combat. Lv20: Full Strength (1.3x damage, trigger % = Str/2); Lv35: Full Strength+ (1.5x damage).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier (heavy hitter, Str-scaling damage multiplier). Pocket Tactics: B tier. fortunesweave.co.uk rates One Chance 2/5 (narrow trigger).

why: Support 2 and Renown 5 here, the cheapest gate of the four routes; he holds the Hammer slot until Esmeralda joins.
recruit.tip: Fish 2 Kothar Gar at Zeet Lake or Kothar Lake.

build.role: Part I Hammer breaker, Part II axe bench
build.notes: Holds the Hammer slot Ch 6 to 8, then hands the Hammer and Giant's Ring to Esmeralda. Bench from Ch 9: the Arena Warrior course trains Sword, Axe and Gauntlet B, and Warrior comes on Part II Ch 2's free License at Lv 35.

guide.role: Part I Hammer breaker, Part II axe bench
guide.summary: Holds the [[item:Hammer]] slot for Ch 7 and 8, then hands it to Esmeralda and becomes a Part II axe bruiser. On the map, walk him to armor and swing [[art:Spike]] when the forecast is under 80. From Ch 9 his job is the Arena: three B ranks for a Part II [[class:Warrior]].
guide.playstyle: Player phase only: swing arts at foes that can't double him, so One Chance (Atk +5) and Full Strength (x1.3) both fire. Crash forbids follow-ups on both sides, which turns One Chance on by itself.
keys: Recruit late Ch 6 at Renown 5 (Support 2, 2 Kothar Gar); he joins at about Lv 15
Take [[class:Brigand]] at Lv 20 (Axe C, Sword C) in Ch 7; Hammer the armored map
Hand the [[item:Hammer]] and [[item:Giant's Ring]] to Esmeralda in Ch 9 prep
Book the Arena Warrior course every week from Ch 9: Sword, Axe and Gauntlet B
Grab a second Hammer from Nemea Cavern (Ch 10) for his Part II six
Take [[class:Warrior]] on Part II Ch 2's free License at Lv 35
watch: Hit: Hammer 60, Iron Axe +3 65 plus its Dex. Always swing an art; a bare Hammer misses a third of the time
Weight: Hammer 20 against Bld + 4 (Giant's Ring); Part III Silver Axe +2 (or Iron Axe +4) 9-10 against the same. If the forecast shows a foe doubling, One Chance is off.
Spear is an avoided skill: no armored classes for him
Inventory: 6/6 from Ch 12 (Hammer, Iron Axe +3, Short Axe, Iron Gauntlets, Ring, Elixir)
